activity.notes: After Lin Sen's death in 1943, Chiang resumed the chairmanship of the National Government and held it until the constitutional presidency replaced that head-of-state structure in May 1948.

sources.title: President Chiang Kai-shek and the Republic of China — National Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
sources.citation_text: The National Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall describes Chiang's rise after the Northern Expedition, his chairmanship of the National Government, wartime national leadership, and election as constitutional president in 1948.

sources.title: Hoover acquires personal papers of Lin Sen — Hoover Institution
sources.citation_text: Hoover notes that Lin Sen became chairman of the Nationalist government in 1931 and held that office until his death in 1943, confirming the interruption between Chiang's two chairmanships.
